welcome_lead: Why are some countries rich and others poor? 🌏
meta_desc: Global Economy Adventure 3 — KS3 Economics on development and global inequality.
final_note: You learned about rich and poor countries, GDP and what helps countries develop.

concepts.def: Total value of goods and services made
Country with high income and services
Country with lower income, still growing
Money or help given to poorer countries
Unfair gap between rich and poor

walkthroughs.body_html:
GDP measures everything a country makes.

USA, China and Germany have huge GDP. Small countries can have small GDP but still be rich per person.

Developed countries (UK, Japan) have good schools, hospitals and infrastructure.

Developing countries are still growing — they may have weaker services and lower wages.

The gap is called inequality.

Rich countries often give aid:

  • Cash for emergencies.
  • Loans for schools and roads.
  • Doctors and engineers.

The goal: sustainable growth that doesn't wreck the planet. 🌱
